summary: Implemented `total=None` support for Progress tasks. Changes: rich/progress.py (Optional total on Task/add_task, remaining/time_remaining return None for unknown total, completion checks guarded, BarColumn pulses when total is None, TotalFileSizeColumn/MofNCompleteColumn/DownloadColumn show "?"), rich/progress_bar.py (ProgressBar accepts total=None and pulses; percentage_completed returns 0), tests/test_progress.py (3 new tests), CHANGELOG.md (Added entry). tests/test_progress.py passes 39/39. Full suite: 13 failures in syntax/markdown/card/traceback tests, identical on original code; tests/test_pretty.py not collected because `attr` is missing from the shared venv (not installed, per instructions). Nothing committed. Design choices: update/reset(total=None) still mean "no change", so a total cannot be cleared back to None.
